description: Election Commission - Declared Elected as a Member of the Ninth Parliament, Mr. W. G. N. P. Wasalathilaka for the Electoral District No. 19 Badulla
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a parliamentary vacancy due to a resignation, which falls under electoral processes. It involves the Election Commission's actions regarding a member of parliament vacancy, including the declaration of a new elected member to fill that vacancy. This content directly relates to election administration and parliamentary membership changes, making it clearly an Elections Gazette (Type 7) rather than a government personnel or structural change.
